_readme: Home page data (/). 'featured' = the Featured Topics groups, in page order. Each group's tiles come from the menus, icons included, so a page added to a menu shows up here on its own: "cocNav": true = coc-nav-data.json (lobby, tools, every Town Hall's layouts + armies); "gameNav": "<key>" = that game's groups/pages in game-nav.json, soon flags included. ?filter views and repeated links are skipped. 'tiles' = extra pages no menu lists (name, sub, link, icon, soon?). 'title'/'link'/'icon' = the group header. Paths are root-absolute.
